title: Juicy Sweet Peruvian Sweet Potato Picarones
description: Rich and juicy Peruvian picarones filled with sweet potato and prosciutto, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and dairy-free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375 degrees.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, anise seeds, cinnamon, and salt.
In a separate bowl, combine the pumpkin puree, coconut milk, eggs, and sugar, and mix well.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 6 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a few pieces of diced sweet potato and prosciutto in the center.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Fry the picarones in the hot oil for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown.
Drain the picarones on paper towels and serve warm.
